dossier.summary: Oakfield Insurance Brokers places commercial and personal lines for about 4,000 clients. Account managers renew policies by hand each quarter.

reasons.team: We assumed about 1 in 10 of the 51 to 200 people spend time on renewals, mostly account managers and their assistants.
reasons.hours: Pulling policy details, re-keying them into carrier portals and chasing signatures. We assumed 8 hours a week each.
reasons.rate: Pay for an account manager plus benefits and overhead, in US dollars. Change it if your blended cost is different.
reasons.tools: A policy system add-on and a few spreadsheets. You will know the actual figure.
